title: Demographic parity
caption: Equal positive selection rates across groups. The credit service fails it: 55% vs 40% approval — a 15-point gap, and a 0.73 selection ratio under the four-fifths diagnostic.

symbols.name: rate
symbols.meaning: The selection rate within a group.

title: Equalized odds
caption: Both error rates — true and false positive — must match across groups. The credit matrices violate it: ~40% false-negative rate for B against ~10% for A, even where scores stay calibrated.

title: The representation cost of a rare subgroup
caption: To bound a 1% subgroup's error within 1pp at 95% confidence you need ~10,000 of its samples. Random collection expects 100× more total images than recruiting the subgroup directly — representation is a budget, not an aspiration.

symbols.name: random sample
symbols.meaning: Images needed via independent random sampling.

symbols.name: subgroup target
symbols.meaning: Samples required for the error bound (~10,000).

symbols.name: group share
symbols.meaning: The subgroup's fraction of the population (0.01).

title: Carbon per GPU-hour
caption: The chapter's baseline: a 0.4 kW accelerator hour at 0.4 kg CO₂eq per kWh emits 0.16 kg. At GPT-3 scale — 1,287 MWh — the run exceeds 100 passenger-car-years.

symbols.name: hourly emission
symbols.meaning: CO₂eq per GPU-hour at these assumptions.

title: Audit log volume
caption: Recorded events per unit time × bytes per event × retention window — sized like any storage budget before the log fills or the bill lands.

title: The four-fifths diagnostic
caption: A group's selection rate below 80% of the highest group's flags adverse impact under the 1978 US employment guidelines. 40%/55% = 0.73 — under the line.

symbols.name: lowest rate
symbols.meaning: Selection rate of the least-selected group.

symbols.name: highest rate
symbols.meaning: Selection rate of the most-selected group.
